name: selfjev-4b
recipe: selfjev finetune from scratch: new LoRA r64 on attention + DeltaNet projections, shared-prefix tree training (selfjev.qwen35_tree), lr 2e-4, 1 epoch; 79,943 non-test questions of data/all.jsonl.gz (incl. llm_multilabel_v1, numdate_neg_v1), texts <= 16K tokens; target 0.5 x verified label + 0.5 x Jev's probabilities; options listed in the question
serve: python -m selfjev.vllm_qwen35 merge --adapter weights/selfjev_4b --out runs/selfjev_4b/merged  # then vllm_qwen35 serve
note: default model since 2026-09-26, replacing qwen35_4b_tree (eval2 95.6, dev 84.4, eval_llm 82.1): best on eval2 and eval_llm (Jev 92.5), fewer confident mistakes; lower on the dev benchmark's public emotion set (Jev's targets). Best-by-validation checkpoint (step 1,800 of 1,803).
